perspective:
Bradley Ochoa’s available information:

- He is a salesperson at the marketing firm; Katherine Lasiloo is his colleague and the marketing manager. He experiences their relationship as professional and generally cordial, though strained when they disagree about traditional sales versus digital marketing.
- In the meeting room, he prepared data and charts from the last five campaigns to support his belief in traditional sales methods. He feels those methods are being sidelined. He hears Katherine acknowledge his point, say the market is evolving, emphasize digital outreach and online engagement, and propose analyzing the data together to integrate both approaches.
- After the meeting, Katherine shares recent digital campaign success stories that show increased engagement and sales. Bradley asks how those strategies are developed. He hears her explain audience/message targeting and the analytics/decision-making behind a recent campaign. He feels uncertain, begins to question his prior stance, admits his doubts, and says he wants to understand the digital approach better. Katherine welcomes this and suggests going deeper into the data.
- Bradley proposes a joint strategy meeting. Katherine agrees. They discuss scheduling, brainstorming, and outlining next steps. He says a combined approach could strengthen their campaigns and appreciates her willingness to collaborate; she says combining their strengths could lead to better results.
- After the joint meeting, Bradley is excited and works overtime to prepare a board presentation draft integrating both their ideas. He shows it to Katherine. She praises it as comprehensive and well thought out and says his hard work shows. He says he is convinced the integrated approach will set them apart from competitors and wants to nail the presentation. She says she is confident and suggests fine-tuning it once more.
- After the presentation succeeds and the new strategy is implemented, Bradley feels grateful for his professional growth and the collaboration. He thanks Katherine, says he learned much from her, and proposes regular strategy sessions. She agrees, saying regular sessions will keep them on top of their game and market trends.
